title: Legacy CPAT bug fixes: other mitigation bugs, batch 2 (v0.5.4 register)
others: the first other-mitigation plan (L13-L50, L135, L136), the engineer power plans and the engineer road-transport plan
policy: Policy block: copy the fixed baseline row and Paste Special → Formulas onto the policy row given. Up to row ~6070 the policy block is the baseline + 6,331 rows; after it + 6,317. Where a paste would point at the wrong row, the policy formula is spelled out.
extra: Expected effects from the register (excel_ai/working_version/LegacyBugFixes_v5_4.md) and the prototype, which fixes every one of these bugs. Nothing was recalculated in Excel or Python.
Formulas were read from the .xlsb itself where the LibreOffice conversion loses them (formulas with IFNA become constants); every 'formula now' of sheet Mitigation was checked against the .xlsb.
Items marked 'to confirm' in the notes take the prototype's choice; confirm before applying.
summary: The 45 other-mitigation bugs of the register that had no cell-level plan (L51, L57-L66, L68-L73, L75-L82, L85-L87, L89-L94, L96-L106): ETS and existing carbon pricing, prices and subsidies, fuel use and exemptions, local pollutants, revenue, GDP effects, the Manual inputs, Multipliers and Elasticities tabs. L92 does not reproduce in this file; L66 is covered by the existing plan L43. Added 2026-10-19: L112 (apply with L87) and three bugs found while planning, L115-L117.
order: Suggested order: L87 (regulations) and the Medium items, then the Low items by block (ETS L61-L65, L78, L80; prices L60, L81, L82; fuel use L89-L94; revenue L69-L73, L85; manual inputs L96-L106).
